_DESIGN_RULE: Exactly 6 products, strictly 1:1 with the 6 needs - one dedicated pure answer each, no duals, no product answering two needs. Products are NOT deck cards: they live in an always-visible tray (see cards.json). Margins form a deliberate 7-6-5-4-3-2 ladder so that WHICH need you reveal is itself a result worth caring about - a flat payout would make the reveal outcome interchangeable. Customer-facing price is not tracked; the Affordability need already represents it.
